page: Microsoft Azure D16ns_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dnv6 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The instance has no local storage, but it is Premium Storage capable, and it does not include any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in specific workloads. The single-threaded gzip compression speed reaches 31.44 GB/sec, and Geekbench text processing scores 2637.0, both placing in the top 25% tier. For language model tasks, the server achieves top-tier performance in text generation for small 135M models at 404.96 tokens/sec. Most other metrics, including stress-ng CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Redis SET operations, fall within the average range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the D16ns_v6 offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of local storage. The absence of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring reliance on external Premium Storage. This virtual machine is suited for web serving, software compilation, text processing, database operations, and lightweight machine learning inference tasks.
